annotations.title: Get the agent's portable identity proof (read-only)

description: Read-only view of the identity this MCP would prove with PHANTOM_IDENTITY_PRIVATE_KEY: the derived public key, the deployment's attestation address (from GET /.well-known/phantom-identity.json) and the exact EIP-712 IdentityBinding domain/types a counterparty must use to verify a proof-of-possession. NEVER re-binds: the authoritative binding state (issued_at/epoch) lives server-side and the API exposes only POST /v1/identity/bind and /rotate. The private key is used ONLY to derive the public key locally; it never leaves this process. Optional agent_id is echoed into the proof so a verifier knows which binding this key claims.

agent_id.description: Optional portable agent identifier this key claims (echoed into the proof).

name: phantom_identity_proof

text.description: Response body of the IDPHANTOM API as a JSON string.

isError.description: True when the API call failed; text carries { error: { code, message } }.
